units.source_text: 当然，金钟儿并非厌弃世俗才进壶里的。

en.t: Of course, the bell cricket did not enter the jar because it had grown weary of the world.

units.source_text: 纵然在壶里，恐怕它也不会知道是在其中。

en.t: Even inside the jar, it probably would not know that it was there.

units.source_text: 并且传宗接代地生存下去。

en.t: And it would go on living, generation after generation.
